decisions.reason: As a low-risk burner component embedded in the established radiant-heating business, its continued fit with core offerings and the firm's growth-related slack make retention more likely than withdrawal.

This industrial electric infrared hall-heater line remains close to the firm's application base and broad system offer, so management would keep it while using further market feedback to refine the range rather than exit it.

Because the hydrogen-capable dark infrared heater is strategically central to the firm's lower-carbon direction and has already been demonstrated in real operation, any performance shortfall would more likely trigger continued development than discontinuation.
